Automated analysis by DharmaNexus detects extensive Pali-internal text reuse, identifying 198 matches across 33 Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Additional substantial reuse appears in adjacent or related Apadāna narratives, such as the *Nandakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 547), *Vaṅgīsattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 546), *Lakuṇḍabhaddiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 543), and *Paṭācārātherīapadāna* (Thi-Ap 20), reflecting shared formulaic verse sequences [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also aligns segments of the text with the Tibetan *Vinayavastu*, the Sanskrit *Lalitavistara*, and the Chinese *Madhyama Āgama* (T 26), though these represent uncurated machine matches rather than direct textual parallels [DharmaNexus].
